name: Tackler metrics (override detection, daily metrics line, weekly precision report)

knobs.note: BH-7728: 0 stops every verb of bin/unblock-metrics.sh before any read. Out of range is one warn line in logs/unblock-metrics.log and the default.
BH-7728: hours after a Tackler act in which a person's reversal (a verdict, a dequeue, a setting) counts as an override and demotes the class to ask_first. Spec: inside 24 h.
BH-7728: the most candidate acts one override pass checks; the rest wait for the next hourly pass.
BH-7728: the UTC weekday (1 = Monday, 7 = Sunday) of Tackler's weekly precision report, sent once per ISO week through Archie's beat gate by bin/staff/tackler-report.sh.
Test seam: epoch seconds bin/unblock-metrics.sh uses as now, only when HARNESS_TEST_SANDBOX=1. NOT settable from the control plane.
Test seam: epoch seconds bin/staff/tackler-report.sh uses as now, only when HARNESS_TEST_SANDBOX=1. NOT settable from the control plane.
Test seam gate: bin/unblock-metrics.sh honours UNBLOCK_NOW and bin/staff/tackler-report.sh honours TACKLER_NOW only when this is 1. Never set on a box, and NOT settable from the control plane.
